description: The semantic-stage twin of `sprites/ask-body-is-a-block-scope` and `sprites/each-body-is-a-block-scope`: a name born in an `ask` or an `each` body is not visible after it (spec/execution-model.md:603-605,664-666), so both reads are `ol-undefined-var` (spec/error-model.md:102). Both halves are asserted in one program because the checker reports every read, which is exactly what the two execute fixtures cannot do — execution stops at the first error. Added at the QA reviewer's request during the review gate, which enumerated every `check: true` fixture in the corpus carrying an `ask` or `each` body (`ask-checks-clean`, `each-checks-clean`, `ask-unknown-without-sprites`, `each-unknown-without-sprites`, `shape-checks-clean`) and found all of them to be about clean parses or unknown commands, none about variable scope — then built a checker that leaks a Sprites body's bindings outward and measured it surviving all 1029 fixtures.
